name: Colmar Dentistry For Kids
description: Pediatric dentistry in Montgomeryville with Dr. Kathryn Leahey, DMD. A dental home for kids who still need the visit to feel kind.

hero.headline: A dental home for kids
hero.sub: Dr. Kathryn Leahey is the pediatric dentist at Colmar Dentistry For Kids. The job is good oral habits that last, taught without rushing a nervous child.

offerings.heading: Built for children, not a scaled-down adult chair.
items: Pediatric exams that teach habits instead of scolding them.
A first visit planned so the room feels known before the work starts.
Conservative options when a child needs treatment, not a sales ladder.

story.heading: Welcome to the practice
paragraphs: Dr. Kathryn Leahey is the friendly, experienced pediatric dentist named on the homepage. Colmar Dentistry For Kids sits at 671 Bethlehem Pike in Montgomeryville.
The site is thin. The promise is not.

experience.heading: What the first visit is for.
items: The room is introduced before the tools.
Parents stay when the child needs them in the chair.
The plan is prevention first, treatment when it earns its place.

feature.heading: Habits that outlast the sticker
feature.text: The homepage says she will help them learn good oral habits so they can enjoy a beautiful smile for a lifetime. That is the work.

spotlight.heading: Montgomeryville and the towns around it
spotlight.text: If Bethlehem Pike is on the way home from school, this is the dental home that fits the route.

contact.heading: Find the kids office.
contact.sub: 671 Bethlehem Pike, Montgomeryville. Confirm hours on the official site.
